item.title: Something special coming to Scooters this Monday
item.description: Before our official opening, we’re excited to celebrate our community with a Family & Friends Event at our 1121 W Fort Scott Street location on December 23rd from 10am to 12 PM.Swing by for a free small drink, meet our baristas, and help them get some practice before the big day.We can’t wait to see you — stop by Butler's new Scooter’s Coffee, say hi, and enjoy a drink on us!

item.title: Structure fire in Archie
item.description: The Adrian fire department has been called to assist with a structure fire on Ford road in Archie, exact address unknown. Please us caution of traveling in the area.Updates will be provided accordingly.

item.title: Obituary - Marcia D. Southard
item.description: Marcia D. Southard, 96, of Harrisonville, Missouri, passed away on Friday, December 19, 2025, at the Kansas City Hospice House in Kansas City, MO. A visitation will be held at the Atkinson Funeral Home in Harrisonville, MO, from 10:00 to 11:00 AM on Friday, December 26, 2025, with the funeral service to follow at 11:00 AM. Burial in Floral Hills Cemetery, Kansas City, MO.A complete obituary will be posted when it becomes available.

item.title: Blackhawks bring home plenty of medals from Katy Trail tournament
item.description: Both the boys and the girls competed really hard at the always tough Battle of the Katy Trail 2 day tournament. 46 teams on the boys side and 50 teams on the girls side. The Lady Blackhawks scored 215 points as a team and are bringing home a second place trophy with 5 individual medalists!! The Boys wrestled tough and are coming home with a finalist!Individual Girls results:105 - Danika Keyton 5-2 7th Place110 - Dallys Shaffer 3-1 2nd place Medalist115 - Nyiomi Bradley 0-2120 - Mia Bosch 0-2125

item.title: Burn ban in effect until further notice
item.description: The Rich Hill Fire Department has issued a burn ban to be in effect until we get some measurable amounts of rain- which would be good advice for all throughout the region as even light winds can create a substantial hazard as the landscape is extremely dry at this time.
